Question
========
Two people have the same income, but one of them uses a wheelchair in a city without accessible transport. In the capability approach, what explains the difference in their well-being?

Answerlist
----------
* Conversion factors
* The Gini coefficient
* The difference principle
* Marginal productivity

Solution
========
Conversion factors (personal, social, environmental) determine whether resources can be turned into functionings. Equal income does not mean equal real freedom.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
